source_boundary.financial_truth: OANDA transaction cash flows and OANDA executable bid/ask candles
source_boundary.features_only: Dukascopy tick/M1 may later generate causal technical features but cannot settle OANDA fills or broker order sequencing

path_rules.entry: actual OANDA fill; LONG enters ask and exits/marks at bid, SHORT enters bid and exits/marks at ask
path_rules.mfe: observed favorable executable-side S5 wick excursion from actual entry
path_rules.mae: observed adverse executable-side S5 wick excursion from actual entry
path_rules.tp_pre_mae: observed adverse excursion strictly before the first unambiguous touch of the then-active versioned TP
path_rules.fill_and_close_boundary: Any touch in an S5 containing fill or terminal close is UNRESOLVED without tick ordering
path_rules.protection_change_boundary: Any touch in an S5 containing create/cancel/replace is UNRESOLVED
path_rules.same_s5_dual_touch: UNRESOLVED; STOP-first and TP-first may be diagnostics only
path_rules.gaps: Any missing 5-second endpoint inside a market-open holding interval makes strict path false. Observed extrema remain lower-bound diagnostics and are never filled.
path_rules.output_missing: null with reason code, never zero

concurrent_margin.required_margin_proxy: gross trade-level proxy: actual entry OANDA tradeOpened.initialMarginRequired divided by entry units, multiplied by causal remaining units; implied instrument margin rate is retained as a diagnostic and never forced to one cross-pair constant
concurrent_margin.unit_timeline: actual entry fill, each partial reduction, terminal close
concurrent_margin.netting: broker account/position netting state is missing, so gross trade-level sums are not account marginUsed
concurrent_margin.admission: proxy may compare relative gross exposure but cannot certify account-wide margin safety
